title: Book an appointment
summary: Find the patient, pick a doctor and a time, and book.

steps.title: Start a booking
steps.narration: To book an appointment, tap New appointment. You can do this from any page.

steps.title: Find the patient
steps.narration: Patient comes first. Type a name, a clinic number or a phone number. The matching patients appear as you type.

steps.title: Pick the patient
steps.narration: Tap the right person in the list. Check the age and the file number to be sure it is the right one. If they are new, tap New patient instead and add them first.

steps.title: Choose the doctor
steps.narration: Now choose the doctor. Once you do, the free times for that doctor appear below.

steps.title: Set the time
steps.narration: Type the start time. The date is today unless you change it. Use the duration list for a longer visit.

steps.title: What kind of visit
steps.narration: Choose the kind of visit: new patient, follow-up, procedure or emergency. This helps the doctor prepare.

steps.title: Add details
steps.narration: If you need to, tap Add details to note the reason for the visit. This is optional, so you can skip it when you are in a hurry.

steps.title: Book it
steps.narration: Check the details, then tap Book appointment.

steps.title: On the calendar
steps.narration: Done. A message at the bottom confirms it. The appointment is now on the calendar, and on the doctor's Today screen. The patient can be reminded by message before the visit.
